summary: Backend-only QA for MyShopEdge Stripe billing on FastAPI at 127.0.0.1:8801 with local Postgres. Converted the QA harness into a pytest suite (9 tests) covering plans catalog, trial-start via SetupIntent, GET subscription, auth requirement, webhook lifecycle (past_due w/ idempotency, active recovery, canceled), unknown-customer no-op, and bad-signature rejection. All 9 tests passed. DB row correctly transitions and stripe_customer_id/stripe_subscription_id/trial_end/current_period_end are populated.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py maps Stripe 'incomplete' -> 'none' in GET; verify this is the intended UX for a freshly-created trial that has not yet completed card auth (currently DB stays 'trialing' which the tests exercise).
Webhook handler correctly returns 200 for unknown customers (idempotent/no-op) and 400 for forged signatures — matches Stripe best practice.
SECURITY DEFINER functions are the only write path; ensure they are still granted only to the service role (not exposed via PostgREST/anon).
seed_data_creation: Reused the single existing subscriptions row for account 56e487ea-e0fa-3691-7857-724855e716fc. Trial-start test may reset Stripe subscription id (idempotent by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Non-standard stack: service at 127.0.0.1:8801, Postgres at 127.0.0.1:5432/myshopedge, no Mongo, no supervisor. Do not restart services. Stripe secrets are in /app/service/.env; the test file loads them itself. Webhook signing: HMAC-SHA256 of '<ts>.<raw_body>' with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Card confirmation via js.stripe.com is not reachable from this container — that's environment, not a code bug.
